title: Factory HoloMap Markers
subtitle: Room and route markers for the starter factory
summary: HoloMap markers identify Factory Substation anchors, high-voltage trunks, Field Battery rooms, depot lanes, and runtime hotspots.
body: Place markers where the factory changes responsibility: generation, storage, high-voltage routing, logistics, and machine hall boundaries. PowerGrid also contributes loaded node markers for substations, high-voltage trunks, and Field Battery Banks when HoloMap is present.
